payload.text: {"summary":"Curated geckoterminal into a user-centric Aomi app for the story 'Track DeFi pools: trending pools, prices, volumes, recent trades'. The app ships 10 curated tools (down from 20 raw endpoints): geckoterminal_list_networks, get_trending_pools, get_top_pools, get_new_pools, search_pools, get_pool (single+multi), get_pool_ohlcv, get_pool_trades (with min_volume_usd whale filter), get_token (composite: token profile + top pools in one call), and get_token_price (batch, up to 30 addresses). Dropped endpoints: tokens_address_info, pools_pooladdress_info, tokens_inforecentlyupdated, tokens_multi_addresses — metadata/socials surfaces out of scope for pool tracking. This session verified coverage against the spec's 20 operations, then applied the skill's spec-trim discipline: removed UI-only image_url/banner_image_url fields from the two LLM-visible response schemas in openapi.yaml and regenerated the client via aomi-build gen-client geckoterminal --force. cargo build passes clean. PREAMBLE reconciled with shipped tools (conventions: network slugs, JSON:API shape, string-typed numerics, ~30 calls/min rate limit). test.json seeded with user_story: 'Show me the trending pools on Base right now, then deep-dive the top one: its current price, 24h volume and liquidity, and any recent trades over $10k.' All tools hit the public API — no auth shim needed. Edits scoped to apps/geckoterminal (plus the pre-existing one-line workspace-exclude entry in root Cargo.toml); no ext/ changes were required since the app is app-local.","changedFiles":"apps/geckoterminal/openapi.yaml, apps/geckoterminal/src/client/client.rs (regenerated), apps/geckoterminal/src/client/mod.rs (regenerated), apps/geckoterminal/src/tool.rs, apps/geckoterminal/src/lib.rs, apps/geckoterminal/test.json, apps/geckoterminal/Cargo.toml, Cargo.toml (workspace exclude entry)","followUps":"Run /aomi-app-e2e-tester geckoterminal to expand test.json into a full multi-turn spec and verify end-to-end. Optionally smoke-test interactively with aomi-run target/debug/libgeckoterminal.dylib. If richer token metadata (socials, gt_score) is ever wanted, the dropped token_info endpoints can be re-exposed as a geckoterminal_get_token_info tool."}
